definition: to be called a particular name by people
description: In an old cafe with an arched doorway, patterned floor tiles, carved wooden panels, a hanging lantern and a ceiling fan, a smiling young man in a rust shirt and cream trousers stands in the middle with a grey parrot with a red tail on his shoulder. Seated men holding small glasses of mint tea laugh and point at him. The parrot spreads its wings, and the young man bends his head down, laughing. A marble table with a glass of mint tea stands in front.

taps.target: the man in the white shirt

taps.phrase: to point at the standing man
taps.target: the man in the dark jumper
